description: Stacked bar chart of alert issues over time, by priority. Built from issue lifecycle timestamps so it agrees with the Open Issues Table.

configuration.name: accountIds
configuration.title: Account IDs
configuration.description: Comma-separated account IDs (e.g. 1234567,7654321). Accepts a dashboard variable, e.g. {{accounts}}.

configuration.name: policyNames
configuration.title: Policy names
configuration.description: Comma-separated policy names to include (exact, case-insensitive). Leave blank for all policies. Accepts a dashboard variable, e.g. {{policies}}.

configuration.name: issueScope
configuration.title: Issues to show
configuration.description: All issues includes ones that have since closed. Only open shows just the issues that are still open now (what the table lists).

configuration.name: lookbackHours
configuration.title: Lookback (hours)
configuration.description: How far back the timeline goes
